<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="th"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><title>Koji vs Mercury Century v10</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0b0b14;--fg:#e8e8f4;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme=light]){--bg:#0b0b14;--fg:#e8e8f4}}
:root[data-theme=dark]{--bg:#0b0b14;--fg:#e8e8f4}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;min-height:100dvh}
#g{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:960px}
#c{width:100%;display:block;image-rendering:auto;background:#000}
#ts{position:absolute;top:8%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#000b;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;opacity:0;transition:.3s;pointer-events:none;text-align:center;width:max-content;max-width:90%}
#dlg{position:absolute;left:11%;width:78%;bottom:2%;aspect-ratio:1500/558;background-size:100% 100%;display:none;color:#eef}
#nm{position:absolute;left:27%;top:30%;width:21%;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(8px,2.2vw,16px);color:#cfd}
#tx{position:absolute;left:28%;top:46%;width:67%;height:42%;font-size:clamp(8px,1.9vw,14px);line-height:1.3;overflow:hidden}
#pt{position:absolute;left:2%;top:8%;width:24%;height:84%;background:#181826;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:clamp(20px,6vw,48px);display:none}
#ov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000c;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:12px;gap:8px}
#ov h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(18px,5vw,34px)}#ov p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(10px,2.4vw,14px);max-width:90%;line-height:1.5}
button{font:inherit}
#ob{padding:8px 20px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid #8a5cff;background:#241b4a;color:#fff;font-size:16px}
#ctl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;gap:8px;width:100%;max-width:960px;box-sizing:border-box}
#js{width:136px;height:136px;border-radius:50%;background:#1d1b3099;border:2px solid #5b4aa8;position:relative;touch-action:none;flex:none}
#kn{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:58px;height:58px;margin:-29px;border-radius:50%;background:#6b55d0;border:2px solid #b9a8ff;pointer-events:none}
#sk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,62px);gap:6px}
.b{height:56px;border-radius:12px;background:#1d1b30;color:#fff;border:2px solid #5b4aa8;font-size:11px;line-height:1.1;touch-action:none;padding:0}
.b:active{background:#4a3a9a}
#cx{padding:0 16px 10px;width:100%;max-width:960px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:12px}
#ci{display:none;flex:1;padding:6px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #5b4aa8;background:#14122a;color:#fff}
</style></head><body>
<div id="g"><canvas id="c" width="640" height="360"></canvas><div id="ts"></div>
<div id="dlg"><div id="pt">👑</div><div id="nm"></div><div id="tx"></div></div>
<div id="ov"><h1 id="ot">💀 KOJI vs MERCURY CENTURY</h1><p id="op"></p><button id="ob">เริ่มเกม</button></div></div>
<div id="ctl"><div id="js"><div id="kn"></div></div>
<div id="sk"><button class="b" data-k="j">⚫<br>BLAST<br>(กดค้าง)</button><button class="b" data-k="k">🌫<br>DUST</button><button class="b" data-k="l">👻<br>SOUL</button><button class="b" data-k="u">👹<br>DEATH</button><button class="b" data-k="i">👑<br>KING</button><button class="b" data-k="o">☠<br>EMPEROR</button></div></div>
<div id="cx"><button class="b" id="cb" style="width:48px;height:32px">⌨</button><button class="b" id="fb" style="width:64px;height:32px">FX ✓</button><input id="ci" placeholder="cheat code แล้วกด Enter"></div>
